name: Gott's Roadside
note: Family friendly, outdoor seating, dogs ok.

name: Small World
note: Family tradition. Get the lamb gyro.

name: Papa Joe's Pizza
note: Best pizza in town. Order ahead.

name: Amami
note: Family friendly. Dinner is the move.

name: Dragon Valley
note: Best Chinese in town. Gap 3–4pm daily.

name: Genova's Deli
note: Always a line. Worth it. Grab a number when you walk in.

name: Model Bakery
note: Always a line. English muffin sandwich is the move.

name: Moulin
note: Always a line. CLOSED Tue and Wed — easy to forget.

name: Earth's Bounty
note: Mom and son vendor. Saturday market only. Burritos and sandwiches made fresh.

name: Oenotri
note: Downtown date-night pizza and pasta choice with strong reviews. Better for sit-down than quick takeout.

name: Bounty Hunter Wine Bar & Smokin' BBQ
note: A reliable downtown BBQ option when the family wants something hearty and easy to share.

name: Kitchen Door
note: Good downtown all-rounder with brunch and takeout flexibility.

name: Contimo Provisions
note: High-quality biscuit and sandwich stop near Copia. Strong local-lunch energy.

name: Croccante Artisan Pizza
note: A newer Napa pizza pick worth keeping in rotation. Weekend brunch is a bonus.

name: Joella's Deli
note: Excellent local truck for fried chicken sandwiches. Exactly the kind of non-chain takeout spot Napkin should favor.

name: Mother's Tacos
note: A strong North Napa taco option with better local upside than chain takeout. Fish and al pastor are the move.

name: Las Palmas
note: Neighborhood Mexican spot with stronger local-review signal than chain burrito places. Great fallback takeout choice up north.

name: North Bar & Grill
note: A good locals-first north-side option for burgers and comfort food, especially when downtown feels like too much effort.

name: Hop Creek Pub
note: A strong west-side locals pub with burgers, sandwiches, and better-than-average comfort food. Worth favoring over generic chain options.

name: Browns Valley Market Deli
note: A genuinely useful local takeout option: paninis, hot case meals, grab-and-go salads, and family backup dinner food.

name: Southside
note: Excellent South Napa breakfast and lunch choice with a strong local following. Fried Chicken Friday makes it more than just a cafe.

name: Taqueria Maria
note: Solid local Mexican option near Soscol with breakfast hours and better all-around takeout utility than chain burrito spots.

name: Stateline Road Smokehouse
note: A standout local BBQ pickup for family meals, especially when you want something more memorable than standard fast food.

name: The Q Restaurant & Bar
address: 3900 Bel Aire Plz, Suite D, Napa
note: Bel Aire BBQ with a solid review history and a good fit for family lunch or easy takeout dinner.

name: Villa Corona
note: A dependable local Bel Aire Mexican standby with breakfast burrito utility and better value than chain alternatives.

name: George + Kin's
note: New Bel Aire diner with strong local-family intent and a playful menu. Worth featuring early while it is fresh and community-focused.

name: Winston's Cafe & Bakery
note: One of the strongest breakfast and bakery picks in town. Great for kid-friendly brunch or a reliable lunch sandwich stop.

name: Naysayer Coffee Roasters
note: A high-quality local cafe with stronger food-and-coffee credibility than a generic coffee run. Good for breakfast and lighter lunch.

name: Loveski Deli
note: High-quality deli food at Oxbow with legit bagels, sandwiches, and an unusually good casual-food ceiling. Easy yes for Napkin.

name: Live Fire Pizza
note: A dependable Oxbow pizza choice with more polish than quick-slice spots and solid group-order utility.

name: Moro Napa
note: Excellent Oxbow wildcard when you want something flavorful and different without sacrificing quality.

name: Napa Valley Bistro
note: Good central Napa fallback when you want a sit-down meal that still feels local and reasonably accessible.

name: Compline
note: One of the stronger downtown food-and-burger spots for adults while still being accessible enough to keep in the rotation.
